bio.text: Juandalynn Givan, a Democrat, has represented District 60 in the Alabama House of Representatives since November 3, 2010.
According to Ballotpedia, she lost the Democratic primary for re-election on May 19, 2026.
She earned a B.A. from Miles College and a J.D. from Miles School of Law, and owns the law firm Givan & Associates.
